comment: Paintings already considered and turned down, so the same candidate is not sourced, resized and measured a second time. Checked before anything else in the add-painting skill, and appended to on every rejection. Reasons: nudity | no-quiet-paint | too-smooth | nothing-busy | cannot-hold-a-week | not-public-domain | duplicate-painter | other.

rejected.title: The Garden of Earthly Delights
rejected.note: Also fails the rate: quietest 29.9 against 18.5 for every painting that has tuned cleanly, so its Monday could not be made easy at any fill or opacity. Either reason alone is disqualifying.

rejected.title: The Fighting Temeraire
rejected.note: Median texture 8.2 -- nothing anywhere for a shape to hide in, so hard-to-scan and visible-once-framed became mutually exclusive. All seven days had to be raised to stay visible and none could be made hard. Caught only after the ramp started aiming at times.

rejected.title: The School of Athens
rejected.note: The Apollo in the upper-left niche is a full-frontal nude statue, and the caryatid figures along the lower frieze are bare-breasted. Depicted sculpture counts. It tuned perfectly well and was in the rotation for a time, which is exactly why the screening step now comes before any measurement.

rejected.title: Netherlandish Proverbs
rejected.note: Two bare-buttocked figures in the outhouse over the water, right of centre -- the 'they both shit through the same hole' proverb. Invisible at thumbnail size and unmissable at the match framing, which is the whole reason the crowded-genre-scene trap is called out in the skill.

rejected.title: Washington Crossing the Delaware
rejected.note: Rates ok (quietest 3.6, busiest 80.6) and plans beautifully -- every day within 2 of its texture rung -- then fails in the browser at the hard end. Search cost 0.97, the lowest of any canvas tried: a short wide painting is only 2600x1666, so there is too little ground to cover for a small shape to stay lost. Saturday and Sunday both had to be raised to stay visible and overshot their scan targets (0.497 against 0.306), breaking the ramp. Two independent re-plans on different spots failed identically, so it is the canvas, not the placement.

rejected.title: The Night Watch
rejected.note: Median texture 15.2 and a search cost of 0.86, worse than the Delaware it was tried as a replacement for. Dark and broadly smooth once reduced to 2600px, so the hard end of the week has nowhere to hide. Not measured in the browser; the rate was decisive.

rejected.title: The Feast of Saint Nicholas
rejected.note: Rated TOO SMOOTH outright: median 12.0 against a floor of 15. An interior with large areas of plain wall and floor -- the hard end of the week cannot hide there.
